name: Python
author: TotalFusion
readme: Calls a function of a Python component of TotalFusion with the data of the message and sends the result to the first output. A failure goes to the second output with a `code` and a `message` (the first line of the error, without the traceback: do not connect that output straight to a public response).

name: Stream
author: TotalFusion
readme: Calls a function that sends chunks (a Python generator or a stream function of Rust or Go) with the data of the message. **Every chunk is a message** on the first output, in order; when the stream ends, one message with `{ chunks, cancelled }` goes to the second output, and a failure goes to the third with a `code` and a `message`. The input `Stop` cancels the streams that are running, and so does stopping the flow. The timeout is the longest time without a new chunk.

name: Events
author: TotalFusion
readme: Sends a message for every event of the workers that you choose: `worker:ready`, `worker:exit`, `worker:recycle`, `worker:unresponsive`, `call:retry` and `reload`. The message has the `event`, when it `at` happened and the data of the event (`runtime`, `pid`, `reason`...). Use it to warn somebody when a worker stops answering or to keep a log.

name: Stats
author: TotalFusion
readme: Sends what the pools of workers are doing (workers, calls, queue, recycled workers, memory of each worker) when a message arrives, and every N seconds if you set it. It is `fusion.stats()`, one entry for each runtime that has started.
